long_description:
*Important News Alert*

We are very grateful for your overwhelming support on Oct 2nd show. Hope to get same support for our next event.

Please join *Desi Dhun Wali Diwali - Deep Jale Sur Mile* next karaoke event of 2026- *Friday, Nov 6th, 2026* event: 

Join us for another unforgettable Bollywood songs. This time theme is 

*Deep Jale Sur Mile* related Bollywood songs lined up. Pick your favourite Bollywood song packed with celebration, togetherness, masti, dhamaka or fireworks! 

*Venue*:

Swagat Restaurant 

1901 Salvio Street 

Concord, CA 94520

*Day & Date*:

Friday, November 6th, 2026, Time: 7:00 pm to 11:30 pm PST

Due to the popularity of our events, *there is a three-step registration process:*

1) Buy your ticket via Zelle at *4086055790*

(Anjali Thadhani) Or *Paypal* at *dollars2mayank* or *4088910959* with *Friends and family* option only.

Please enter note on your purchase - *your name, phone number, singer or listener*

2) After purchasing your ticket, *you will be added to the event group* where you can send/post your selected song and track. *Ticket purchase is required for song selection.*

3) *Singer spot selection* to avoid constant churn of spot adjustment, we have a change in the process. Singer spot selection will happen on *Wed Nov 4th at 7pm*. Please be available online. Singing spots will be offered in the following sequence a. Organisers b. Children and seniors c. General singers 

Ticket prices:

- **Adults (12 & above): $28* , includes $1 tip

- **Children (5-12):$18*, includes $1 tip

 **Children under 5: Free**

We have room for **35 singers** and a few additional spots on the waitlist. Listeners are always welcome!

**Desi Dhun is a community-based, not-for-profit organization dedicated to music lovers.** Your ticket purchases help cover the cost of vegetarian buffet dinner. Event is a *non-alcoholic* event. 

*Cancellation*- full refund, if cancellation is requested by *Nov 3rd, 2026 before 7pm*.

We can’t wait to see you for anot
